      "file": "core/state/artifact-persist.sh",
      "category": "path traversal",

      "line": 644,
      "message": "The new `_artifact_persist_put_back` function guards against absolute-path injection (`/* `) but not against relative dotdot traversal (`../`), so a `rel` value of `../../outside/the/target` would pass the check and write outside `$to`.",
      "quote": "[[ \"$rel\" == /* ]] && continue",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/runner.sh",
      "category": "missing input validation",
      "severity": "low",
      "line": 1800,
      "message": "`--from-stage` accepts any string without validating it against a stage-name character set before the value is embedded in a variable name used for indirect expansion (`${!_fsp_cycle_stages_var:-}`) and in a `warn`/`echo` message to stderr.",
      "quote": "from_stage=\"$2\"; shift 2 ;;",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    }
  ]
}
